Due to a permanent access restriction, no direct route exists connecting Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, owing to a contractual exclusivity clause, the final routing plan must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical links: the connection between Beta and Gamma, or the connection between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient cyclical itinerary that services each facility precisely once before concluding at the point of origin.
